title: Estimating & Cost Intelligence
method: Every P05 requirement carries the same acceptance criterion: 'Demonstrate {module} {aspect} with tenant-specific configuration, role controls, version history, and traceable output.' Each of the 18 modules was judged against each of the 6 aspects, and a verdict is recorded only where a named test asserts the behavior. Where the platform does not do the thing, the verdict is not_verified and the gap is stated. No verdict is inferred from a mapping rule.

evidence_suites.engine_acceptance: packages/engine/tests/estimating-acceptance.test.ts — 43 tests. Traceable output and input validation across every engine that produces an authoritative figure.
evidence_suites.db_acceptance: tests/db/estimating-acceptance.test.ts — 83 tests. Tenant configuration, role controls, version history and auditability against real PostgreSQL.
evidence_suites.rls: tests/db/rls.test.ts — tenant isolation and RULE-009 immutability.
evidence_suites.registry: tests/governance/registry.test.ts — the five-category classification and its invariants.

aspects.canonical model: A defined entity or type with named fields exists for the module.
aspects.configurable rules: Behavior is driven by configuration a company can set, not hard-coded.
aspects.auditability: Changes are recorded with prior and new state in a ledger nobody can rewrite.
aspects.permissions: Access is gated by row level security, forced, and isolated between companies.
aspects.import/export: Data can be brought in and taken out through a tested path.
aspects.validation and testing: Invalid input is refused, and the module is covered by tests that run.

verified.canonical model: estimates and estimate_versions with 50+ governed columns; calculateEstimateLine and calculateEstimate return typed results. db_acceptance 'records a version number against every estimate'; engine_suites estimate.test.ts golden reference line.
verified.configurable rules: shift_hours, calendar_efficiency, fuel_price_per_gallon, swell/shrink and bid_rounding_increment are per-version columns, and the pricing profile is passed in. engine_suites estimate.test.ts.
verified.auditability: db_acceptance 'writes an audit entry when an estimate changes' and 'records the prior and new state', asserting the name changed from one value to the other.
verified.permissions: db_acceptance role controls; rls estimate isolation.
verified.import/export: exportEstimate/importEstimate with a versioned schema. portable.test.ts asserts the priced result and every derivation are identical after a round trip, that a newer schema is refused rather than partly read, and that a missing pricing profile is refused rather than defaulted. 20 tests.

conditions.tenant-specific configuration: Per-version shift hours, calendar efficiency, fuel price, swell/shrink and bid rounding are company configuration, not constants. engine_suites estimate.test.ts.
conditions.role controls: db_acceptance role controls: RLS enabled and forced, one company never sees another's rows, anonymous reads nothing.
conditions.version history: db_acceptance version history: an issued estimate version is immutable (RULE-009), issuing requires an issue date, and a revision is a new version alongside it.

acceptance_conditions.note: Every P05 acceptance criterion demands all four. A requirement is verified only when its module has the aspect AND satisfies all four conditions, each with a named test.
